statement.text: Let $K \subset S^{3}$ be a slice knot. (a) Determine the set $\mathcal{R}(K)$ of ribbon disks bounded by $K$ modulo isotopy. (b) Determine the set $\mathcal{D}(K)$ of slice disks bounded by $K$ modulo isotopy and local knotting. (c) Determine the set $\mathcal{H}\mathcal{R}(K)$ of homotopy-ribbon disks bounded by $K$ modulo isotopy. (d) If $K$ is fibered, determine the set $\mathcal{F}\mathcal{H}\mathcal{R}(K)$ of fibered, homotopy-ribbon disks bounded by $K$ in some homotopy 4-ball, modulo isotopy.

title: Kirby Problem 1.59
